date_basis: Dates reported in 1919 translation; original manuscript and calendar conventions unverified

observations.statement: Colorado raft crossing aided by Quiquima captain and others; approximately three leagues traveled afterward.
Visitors bring shells and describe opposite coast and gulf end; no independent record of their statements inspected.
Illness and boggy banks impede planned raft/horse crossing.
Sea eastward; continuous land reported south, west and north; author interprets as land connection.

dependence: Same author as Kino map; edited translation is not an independent field witness.
